exercises.instruction: Составьте предложения из этих слов. Некоторые предложения вопросительные. Предложения 1–7 должны быть в настоящем времени. Предложения 8–15 должны быть в прошедшем времени.

answers: The office is cleaned every day.
Are these rooms cleaned every day?
The windows are cleaned every two weeks.
This room isn’t used very much.
Are we allowed to park here?
The house was painted last month.

items.prompt: (my phone / steal / a few days ago)
answers: My phone was stolen a few days ago.
Three people were injured in the accident.

items.prompt: (I / not / wake up / by the noise)
answers: I wasn’t woken up by the noise.

items.prompt: (you / invite / to Jon’s party last week?)
answers: Were you invited to Jon’s party last week?

exercises.instruction: В каждом из этих предложений допущена ошибка. Напишите правильные предложения.

items.prompt: Football plays in most countries of the world.
answers: Football is played in most countries of the world.

items.prompt: Why did the letter send to the wrong address?
answers: Why was the letter sent to the wrong address?

items.prompt: A film studio is a place where films make.
answers: A film studio is a place where films are made.

items.prompt: How many languages are speaking in Switzerland?
answers: How many languages are spoken in Switzerland?

items.prompt: Somebody broke into our house, but nothing stolen.
answers: Somebody broke into our house, but nothing was stolen.
